quandoUsar: Navigating folders and nested content in a side panel: a project's files, sections of documentation, categories of a catalog.
When each node needs only a name and an icon, and the user opens and closes branches to reach an item.
When the tree-pattern keyboard is expected: arrow keys to move, open, and close, and Enter to choose.
quandoEvitar: Use `tree-table` when each node has data columns, multiple selection, or children loaded on demand.
Use `file-tree` for a file explorer with change markers and type-ahead search.
Use `animated-sidebar` for an application's navigation menu, with groups that open and a collapsed icon rail.

teclado.acao: Move focus to the previous or next visible item.
Go to the first or last visible item.
Opens the closed folder; on an open folder, moves focus to the first child.
Closes the open folder; on a file or a closed folder, moves focus to the parent folder.
Select the item and call `onSelect`; on a folder, also open or close it.
Enters the tree on the last focused item and leaves it; the other items are outside the `Tab` order.

acessibilidade: It is a single-selection `role="tree"` in which each row is a `<button>` with `role="treeitem"`, `aria-level`, `aria-posinset`, `aria-setsize`, `aria-selected`, and, on folders, `aria-expanded`.
Focus is roving: only one item is in the `Tab` order, and if it disappears because the folder closed, the stop moves to the first visible item.
The default name is `File tree`, in English: pass an `aria-label` describing the content; icons are decorative (`aria-hidden`).
movimento: When a folder opens, the space opens on a single spring and the new children enter in sequence, sliding from the left; on close, they collapse in height and fade quickly.
The selection background glides from one item to another, the arrow rotates 90°, the icon switches between closed and open folder, and the indent guide grows from top to bottom.
With “reduced motion” on, items appear and disappear with no height or displacement, the selection jumps, and icons swap instantly.
responsivo: Each level indents 18 px and the name is truncated with an ellipsis, so deep trees in a narrow panel leave little room for the text.
desempenho: All items of open folders stay in the DOM, each with entrance, exit, and position animation; folders with hundreds of items should start closed.
notasIA: Pass `nodes` (`{ id, label, children?, icon? }`) and `aria-label`; a node with non-empty `children` becomes a folder, and file icons get a color by extension (`.ts`, `.tsx`, `.css`, `.md`, `.json`).
Expansion can be controlled (`expandedIds` with `onExpandedChange`) or not (`defaultExpandedIds`); selection is always internal, starts empty, and can't be set by a prop.
Clicking a folder also selects it and calls `onSelect`: if only files should open content, check `node.children` in the handler.
